 Q 2 Results Today, 03rd November 2026 Live Updates: Among the major and closely watched companies scheduled to announce their Q2 FY27 results on November 3, 2026, are Bajaj Finserv, State Bank of India (SBI), Bajaj Holdings & Investment, Lupin, AIA Engineering, Aarti Drugs, Anthem Biosciences, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, Fortis Healthcare, Metropolis Healthcare, Global Health (Medanta), Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, Asahi India Glass, Bata India, Bayer CropScience, V2 Retail, Minda Corporation, Endurance Technologies, INOX India, Lloyds Metals and Energy, Solar Industries India, Graphite India, Linde India, Gujarat Fluorochemicals, MCX, R Systems International, Awfis Space Solutions, Fractal Analytics, Neuland Laboratories, Nephrocare Health Services, and Utkarsh Small Finance Bank. Other notable names include Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions, Transrail Lighting, Jyoti CNC Automation, Kolte-Patil Developers, Samhi Hotels, Northern Arc Capital, Laxmi Dental, Pokarna, Subex and Rattanindia Enterprises. These companies span banking, financial services, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, automobiles, retail, industrials, metals, technology and real estate.
 Follow our stock market live updates here | Stay tuned to businessline for more.

 V-Mart Retail on Tuesday reported widening of net loss to Rs 16.34 crore for September quarter FY27.
 The company had incurred a loss of Rs 8.87 crore in July-September FY26, according to a regulatory filing from V-Mart, a value retailer.
 Revenue from operations was up 18 per cent year-on-year to Rs 952.99 crore in September quarter FY27. Total expenses were higher by 22 per cent to Rs 976.37 crore. (PTI)
 November 3, 2026 17:32 Knowledge Trust Q2 net operating income rises 15% to ₹1,140 cr; ₹764 cr distribution for unitholders
 (PTI) Knowledge Realty Trust on Tuesday reported a 15 per cent increase in net operating income (NOI) to Rs 1,140.4 crore for the quarter ended September.
 The company declared a distribution of Rs 764 crore to unitholders for the second quarter of this fiscal, according to a regulatory filing.
 Knowledge Realty Trust, which is co-sponsored by Sattva and Blackstone, is one of the leading real estate investment trusts (REITs) in the country.
 November 3, 2026 17:31 Emcure Pharma posts 29.31% rise in PAT to ₹325 cr in Q2
 Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd on Tuesday reported a 29.31 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 325.06 crore during the September quarter helped by a strong growth in international business.
 The pharma company had posted a profit of Rs 251.37 crore in the year-ago period, it said in a regulatory filing.
 Its revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,820.47 crore during the September quarter, up from Rs 2,269.82 crore a year earlier.
 Its total expenses were higher at Rs 2,377.87 crore during the quarter under review, up from Rs 1,931.52 crore a year ago, as per the filing. (PTI)

 Consolidated Revenue: ₹379 crore, up 33% YoY
